content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Overland Park

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and verifiable project-management experience. Review PMI's specific hour requirements for your educational background, then document your project leadership experience. Granite PM Academy's admissions team can clarify whether your background qualifies before enrollment.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Instruction
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual PMP Bootcamp, delivered by active certified practitioners. Attend instructor-led sessions covering the PMBOK® Guide framework, real-world applications, and exam strategy. All classes run online, enabling you to balance certification training with your current role.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing the 35 contact hours, file your PMP application directly with PMI and pay the associated exam fee. Granite PM Academy provides application support to ensure your experience documentation meets PMI's audit standards and accelerates approval.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice questions and strategy sessions, to build confidence. Schedule your exam with PMI's testing partner, then sit for the 180-question, four-hour computer-based assessment. Exam results are available immediately upon completion.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP® Credential
steps_items.text: Earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) throughout the standard three-year renewal cycle by attending training, presenting, or contributing to your local project-management community. Renew your credential with PMI before expiration to keep your PMP® designation current and marketable.
